note: F1a A4 static enumeration. Every className string under app/ and components/ (.ts and .tsx; NOS-host-only code excluded: components/nos-chrome/, components/nos/, components/show/, components/tickets/TicketTypeCard.tsx, app/(nos)/) that carries focus:ring-*, focus-visible:ring-*, ring-offset-*, focus(-visible):outline-none or a focus outline-offset other than [3px] must be THE ONE RING: focus-visible:outline-2 + focus-visible:outline-solid + focus-visible:outline-offset-[3px] (+ an outline colour), with no ring-* utility and no outline-none. Anything else must be listed here with a reason. Each entry names a file and a key (a substring of the className string); one entry per component, never a glob. An entry matching no hit FAILS the check (stale). Unlisted hits FAIL. Rule (lead, revised): the one ring applies to all standalone actions AND form controls on SAOC surfaces. ANY outline-none (bare, focus:, focus-visible:) is a hit: a bare outline-none is the only way to remove a browser default ring, so it must sit in the same class string as the one ring (the focus-visible ring then paints) or be allowlisted; focus:/focus-visible: outline-none is never allowed with the one ring.
